title: Teams For All!
description:
Allows non-opped players to join and leave up to 16 unique-colored teams!
They can join teams through the pause menu.
body:
Allows non-opped players to change their team through their pause menu!
Up to 16 teams can be joined at once, one for each color.
Players can also leave teams as they choose.

DM Nazeistra if you have any issues
